{{Top}}
A '''tensor field''' was a field produced to counter the effects of gravity on suspended objects. Notably, they were used on [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] to prevent the heavily loaded, long 'wings' from sagging during operations in a planet's gravity.
